activate_survey.description: Start a survey taking responses. With Participants only, it gets a participant list first, so only people invited can answer. One already active is left as it is and said so.
activate_survey.name: activate_survey

parameters.description: The survey: pick it, or give its ID, the number LimeSurvey shows beside its title.
parameters.name: survey_id

parameters.description: Make a participant list, if it has none, so only people on it can answer, each with their own link. Off: anyone with the survey's link can.
parameters.name: participants_only

parameters.description: Keep responses apart from who gave them. Can't be changed once the survey is active. Leave blank for the survey's own setting.
parameters.name: anonymized

already_active.description: True when it was active before this step

link.description: The link participants open the survey at

participant_list_created.description: True when this step made its participant list

participants_only.description: True when it has a participant list, so only people invited can answer

add_participants.description: Add people to a survey's participant list, each with their own access code: one from the fields here, and any number more from a list, with attributes such as Department. Send their invitations with Invite participants.
add_participants.name: add_participants

parameters.description: The survey: pick it, or give its ID, the number LimeSurvey shows beside its title.
parameters.name: survey_id

parameters.description: The participant's email address.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: The participant's first name.
parameters.name: first_name

parameters.description: The participant's last name.
parameters.name: last_name

parameters.name: attributes

parameters.description: More people to add, such as rows from a spreadsheet: a list of objects with email, first_name, last_name, language and attributes by name, such as [{"email": "ann@example.com", "first_name": "Ann", "Department": "Sales"}].

participants.description: Each participant given, with their new ID and access code, or why they weren't added

attributes.description: Their extra attributes, by name, such as Department

reminded_at.description: When the last reminder was sent, as LimeSurvey shows it (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, in its own time zone)

add_response.description: Save a response to an active survey, such as one taken on paper, by phone or in another app, with its answers keyed by question code. For a participant, give their access code: they're marked as completed.
